statement: let inside := fun (x y a b X Y : ℝ) => |a*(X-x)+b*(Y-y)| < 1/2 ∧ |(-b)*(X-x)+a*(Y-y)| < 1/2; let fits := fun (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ) => 0 ≤ s ∧ ∃ x y a b : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, a i ^ 2 + b i ^ 2 = 1 ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*x i ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*(s-x i) ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*y i ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*(s-y i)) ∧ (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ X Y : ℝ, inside (x i) (y i) (a i) (b i) X Y → ¬ inside (x j) (y j) (a j) (b j) X Y); fits 17 (9351/2000)

plain_statement.zh: 在边长 4.6755 的正方形中放入 17 个可独立旋转的单位正方形，允许边界接触，内部互不重叠。
plain_statement.en: Pack 17 independently rotatable unit squares in a square of side 4.6755, allowing boundary contact and forbidding overlap of interiors.

brief.zh: 公开基准为 Bidwell 的约 4.6755300936。尝试改变接触关系或旋转分组，再搜索中心坐标与角度。用有理半角参数及分离轴证明候选布局的边界与不相交约束。也请核对同一模型下公开的最优性主张。
brief.en: The documented Bidwell layout has side about 4.6755300936. Explore different contact patterns or orientation groups, then search over centers and angles. Verify the candidate with rational half-angle parameters and separating axes. Review published optimality claims under the same packing model.
